fn CountDigits(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else if (n < 10) then 1 else (1 + CountDigits((n / 10)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (CountDigits(0) == 1)
  example (CountDigits(10) == 2)
{
  if (n == 0) then 1 else if (n < 10) then 1 else (1 + CountDigits((n / 10)))
}

fn PowNat(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (base >= 0)
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * PowNat(base, (exp - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (PowNat(0, 0) == 1)
  example (PowNat(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * PowNat(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn SumPowers(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (k >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else (PowNat((n % 10), k) + SumPowers((n / 10), k))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (SumPowers(0, 0) == 0)
  example (SumPowers(1, 0) == 1)
{
  if (n == 0) then 0 else (PowNat((n % 10), k) + SumPowers((n / 10), k))
}

fn IsArmstrong(n: Int) -> Bool
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (n == SumPowers(n, CountDigits(n))))
  effects pure
  example (IsArmstrong(0) == true)
{
  true
}
